name: amfx-time-poty-contrarian-research
description: amFX reproduction (12DEC25 p2): TIME Person of the Year contrarian stock indicator. When TIME features a corporate leader/industry, stocks average +44% in cover year but -25.7% in the year after. 9 instances from 1928-2025. Only 13% of featured stocks rise the following year. Uses TSLA and AMZN to compute actual recent-instance returns; historical averages displayed in summary.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: TIME Person of the Year Contrarian Indicator (12DEC25 p2)
# =============================================================================
# When TIME Person of the Year features a corporate leader or specific industry,
# the associated stocks tend to underperform significantly afterward.
#
# Historical record (from Donnelly's research):
# 1928 Chrysler (Walter Chrysler): +127.6% cover year, -49.2% after, -58.3% 2yr
# 1929 RCA (Owen D. Young):        -32.3% cover year, -59.1% after, -81.8% 2yr
# 1955 GM (Harlow Curtice):        +41.6% cover year, -3.8% after, -21.1% 2yr
# 1982 Computer basket:            +61.5% cover year, -4.1% after, -20.1% 2yr
# 1991 TBS/A (Ted Turner):         +70.9% cover year, -7.6% after, +17.8% 2yr
# 1997 INTC (Andrew Grove):        +7.0% cover year, +68.8% after, +134.4% 2yr
# 1999 AMZN (Jeff Bezos):          +35.2% cover year, -85.8% after, -75.2% 2yr
# 2021 TSLA (Elon Musk):           +40.4% cover year, -65.0% after, -29.5% 2yr
# Average: +44.0% cover year, -25.7% after, -16.7% 2yr
# Median: +40.4% cover year, -7.6% after, -21.1% 2yr
# % Up: 88% cover year, 13% after, 75% 2yr (note: only 1/8 up after)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Compute annual returns for the three stocks we have data for
# Use 252-day return as annual proxy
ret_1y = roc(period=252)(close)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 1Y Return: Recent TIME Cover Stocks',
    category='TIME POTY Contrarian',
    y_axis_label='1-Year Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Return', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-25.7, title='Avg Post-Cover Return (-25.7%)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=ret_1y)
